alt.en: A tall white card with lines of writing stands at the center of a gray floor. A dotted violet line runs to its base from a sheet of code lying on the floor to the left, and a dotted teal line runs to it from a pair of smart glasses resting on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一张写有文字线条的白色高卡片。左侧地面上平放着一页代码，一条紫色点线从这里通向卡片底部；右侧放着一副智能眼镜，一条青色点线从眼镜通向卡片。

caption.en: Illustration: a decision card recording an invariant and its test, checked from one side by a scripted test and from the other by inspecting recorded behavior. It does not depict Crewroom, any other harness or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：一张记录不变量及其测试的决策卡，一侧由脚本化测试检查，另一侧通过查看行为记录来检查。图中所示并非 Crewroom、其他框架或任何经过测试的实际部署，也不表明这些检查能如文中所述发挥作用。
